title: Dexcom G6/Android 9 BT not pairing with transmitter
body:
I just switched to a pixel 3 with Android 9. I've installed xDrip+, entered my sensor and transmitter info but my phones BT is not finding or pairing to my Dexcom device. Is this a common problem? I know Dexcom will say that the Pixel 3 is not compatible but I figure that's for the Dexcom app. If I start the source setup wizard, the message just remains there for me to set it up. 
Sorry if this has been addressed already. Haven't seen anything specific to my issue. I'm using version d1d4887-2018.09.08

comments.body: I'm having the same problem connecting on Samsung a5. First time using the g6.

Please both of you upgrade to the latest nightly to see if that helps:

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/How-to-get-the-Nightlies-on-Automatic-Update
Many thanks - I have completed action  and requested update. When am I likely to see if it's worked? Stupid question maybe but do I need to wait overnight for a 'nightly. Thanks

Thanks so much. I've updated. Should the sensor status show as stopped when
it's not actually collecting data? I did get some data, but haven't for the
last 30 minutes. Never had any problems with my Nexus 5 and Android 6, so
wondering if it's a 9.0 issue.

I don't know if it will only pair when xdrip sends it a request.I constantly get missed signals. I'm now on the last stable release 01/10. Still the same.
